question: PairTeam 통합 dev 배선 검증; 실제 실행 전 코디네이터가 소스와 예산을 고정한다.
pose_provider_note_ko: 임시, 표식 사용, 연구 결과 아님

cargoX.source: coarse order sheet (setup pose rounded to the sheet grid; static, fixed before the run)

leader_rotation_note: leader_ko leader = r1/r2/r3[trial_seed % 3] (package A leader_for_seed); trial_seed 700 -> r2. The scenario declares seeds 700/701/702 so the rotation covers r1, r2 and r3; this smoke runs 700 only.

gates.P1: every condition writes result.json and study/trial_record.json without an exception (stop in horizon | quiescent_budget_spent)
gates.P2: decision -> executor: every released claim/wait/release reached THAT robot's executor at the release SIM time (dispatch sim_s == call finished_sim_s), with the executor ack recorded; package A validates every call/message/action record; package I parses the trial record (reopen ok)
gates.P3: channels: no_comm sends/receives 0 messages; leader_ko follower->follower 0; structured free text 0; package C inboxes == package D scheduler inboxes
gates.P4: SIM cost: zone_study_offline.cost_checks ok (released - requested == sim_cost_s, charged == scheduler thinking, billed == produced utterances); clock drift between scheduler and physics <= 0.001 s
gates.P5: inputs: every archived request re-hashes; its only image is the robot's own robot_cam frame (sha in own frame log); payload_validated; no TOP / GT / peer key
gates.P6: executor boundary: foreign_frames_fed 0, cameras_seen [robot_cam], pose sources start with owncam_pf_v2: (tags_temporary), weld max eq_active 0, cargo_noslip_v1 noslip_iterations > 0
gates.P7: pair status channel: present with the same config sha256 in all four conditions
gates.P8: labels: pose_provider tags_temporary + note in manifest, result, trial record and the TensorBoard run names

reported_not_gated: eval-only deliveries per order (referee from simulator truth)
calls, messages, think/talk SIM cost per condition
pass_rule: the plumbing smoke passes when P1-P8 hold for all four conditions. Deliveries are reported as observed; no condition comparison is made (fixture decisions, 1 seed).
stop_rule: DRAFT: 물리 및 모델 실행 없음. 실행 전 source_sha, bundle_sha256, 자원/잠금 및 조건 코호트를 별도 확정.
conditions_note: sync SIM, OMP/OPENBLAS/VECLIB/MKL threads 1, load average logged in each manifest; weld OFF; contact profile cargo_noslip_v1 (approved by the user 2026-09-26)
